lines.say: Hi, and welcome to Sort My Cover, by Lead Velocity.
lines.show: Welcome to SortMyCover, by Lead Velocity.

lines.say: In the next three minutes, you'll see exactly what your clients see, from the first ad to the call with you.
lines.show: In three minutes: exactly what your clients see, from the first ad to the call with you.

lines.say: And what lands on your phone along the way.
lines.show: And what lands on your phone along the way.

lines.say: It starts with a short ad on Facebook or Instagram.
lines.show: It starts with a short ad on Facebook or Instagram.

lines.say: Each one names a moment that changes how much cover a family needs.
lines.show: Each one names a moment that changes how much cover a family needs.

lines.say: A new bond. A new baby. Turning forty. Or work cover that stops at a few times salary.
lines.show: A new bond. A new baby. Turning 40. Or work cover that stops at a few times salary.

lines.say: There are no insurer names, no premiums, and no best price claims.
lines.show: No insurer names, no premiums, no “best price” claims.

lines.say: We pay for the ads and run them. You never fund or manage them.
lines.show: We pay for the ads and run them. You never fund or manage them.

lines.say: One tap opens a one minute check on sort my cover dot co dot zed ay.
lines.show: One tap opens a one-minute check on sortmycover.co.za.

lines.say: Five quick taps. Age, bond, family, work cover, and budget.
lines.show: Five quick taps: age, bond, family, work cover and budget.

lines.say: Anyone outside thirty five to fifty, or under seven hundred and fifty rand a month, is thanked and stopped right here.
lines.show: Outside 35–50, or under R750 a month? Thanked and stopped right here.

lines.say: Then a name, a WhatsApp number, and a consent tick that names your practice.
lines.show: Then a name, a WhatsApp number, and a consent tick that names your practice.

lines.say: They can pick a time straight from your live Outlook calendar.
lines.show: They pick a time straight from your live Outlook calendar.

lines.say: Within sixty seconds, they get a WhatsApp that introduces you by name, with your practice and your F S P number.
lines.show: Within 60 seconds: a WhatsApp introducing you by name, practice and FSP number.

lines.say: A lead only counts once they reply or tap. That proves the number is real, and theirs.
lines.show: A lead only counts once they reply or tap. That proves the number is real, and theirs.

lines.say: If they haven't booked yet, a calendar opens right inside WhatsApp, showing only your free slots.
lines.show: Not booked yet? A calendar opens inside WhatsApp, showing only your free slots.

lines.say: Then we help them show up.
lines.show: Then we help them show up.

lines.say: We ask them to type the time back, because people who write it down are more likely to attend.
lines.show: They type the time back. People who write it down are more likely to attend.

lines.say: They get a short note on what to expect, and your own twenty five second intro video.
lines.show: A short “what to expect” note, and your own 25-second intro video.

lines.say: Then a reminder the day before, another two hours before, and a final one ten minutes before the call.
lines.show: Reminders the day before, two hours before, and ten minutes before.

lines.say: No pressure, and nothing to buy.
lines.show: No pressure, and nothing to buy.

lines.say: On your side, you get a heads up the moment they book. It's already in your Outlook.
lines.show: On your side: a heads-up the moment they book. It's already in your Outlook.

lines.say: At half past seven each morning, a list of the day's calls.
lines.show: 07:30 every morning: the day's calls.

lines.say: And fifteen minutes before each call, a short brief, with their age band, budget band, and what they asked.
lines.show: 15 minutes before each call: a brief with age band, budget band and what they asked.

lines.say: You take the call and give the advice. From there, the client is yours.
lines.show: You take the call and give the advice. From there, the client is yours.

lines.say: Fifteen minutes later, we ask for three quick taps. Did they attend? How good was the fit? And a score out of five.
lines.show: 15 minutes later, three taps: attended? how good a fit? a score out of 5.

lines.say: It takes about twenty seconds, and it tells us which ads deserve more of the budget.
lines.show: About 20 seconds. It tells us which ads deserve more of the budget.

lines.say: If someone doesn't book, they get three gentle nudges over three days, and then we stop.
lines.show: Didn't book? Three gentle nudges over three days, then we stop.

lines.say: If they miss the call, they get one friendly message with three new times.
lines.show: Missed the call? One friendly message with three new times.

lines.say: No shows, wrong numbers, and leads outside the agreed criteria are replaced.
lines.show: No-shows, wrong numbers and leads outside the criteria are replaced.

lines.say: You pay one flat price for each thirty day cycle, with the ads included.
lines.show: One flat price per 30-day cycle, ads included.

lines.say: There's no contract and no notice period, and the price never depends on how many policies you write.
lines.show: No contract, no notice period. Never tied to how many policies you write.

lines.say: If we fall short of your committed number, the cycle runs on for up to fourteen days, and anything still missing is credited.
lines.show: Short of your committed number? Up to 14 extra days, then a pro-rata credit.

lines.say: Every Monday morning, a short report on WhatsApp shows how your week went.
lines.show: Every Monday: a short WhatsApp report on your week.

lines.say: That's it. We fill your diary with people who want to talk. You do what you do best.
lines.show: We fill your diary with people who want to talk. You do what you do best.
